# Amir Shaul - IT System Engineer & Infrastructure
> Official Portfolio & Professional Profile: https://www.amirshaul.online/

## About
Amir Shaul is a professional IT System Engineer and System Administrator based in Holon / Tel Aviv, Israel. He specializes in enterprise IT infrastructure, AWS Cloud environments, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, Exchange Servers, Terminal Servers (RDS), and Cybersecurity.

## Current Role
- **Company:** Kali Group (קבוצת קלי)
- **Position:** IT System Administrator & Engineer (Since July 2025)

## Professional Expertise
- **Cloud & Identity:** AWS Cloud Infrastructure, Microsoft Entra ID, Single Sign-On (SSO), MFA, Identity & Access Management (IAM).
- **Enterprise Messaging:** Microsoft 365, Exchange Server Administration, Hybrid Deployments.
- **Directory & Virtualization:** Active Directory, Group Policy (GPO), Terminal Servers / Remote Desktop Services (RDS).
- **Automation & Security:** PowerShell scripting, AI-driven IT workflows, Endpoint Security, Network Administration.
